caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic teapot positioned centrally on a plain, lightly textured beige background. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray and silver, suggesting a polished metal surface, with subtle highlights and shadows indicating its rounded, three-dimensional shape. It features an ornate handle on the left and a curved spout on the right, both with detailed embellishments. The body of the teapot is decorated with an engraved floral design, including large blossoms and multiple leaves. A horizontal band with a leaf pattern encircles the upper portion beneath the lid. The lid of the teapot is dome-shaped, topped with a small knob. The artist’s signature, "V. White," is present below and to the right of the teapot. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Silver Teapot
